# Level editor assets (generated by `cargo xtask format-docs`; do not edit)

Files: `asset.ron` ([AssetFile](#assetfile)), `images/<source>`, `layers/<id>.png`, `layers/<id>.material.png`, `layers/<id>.back.png`, `masks/<id>.png`, `glow/<id>.png`, `surface/<id>.png`, `surface/<id>.back.png`, `sounds/<file>`, `script.rhai`, `thumb.png`.

An asset (issue #9): a ready-made piece of a level saved once and dropped into any level by the editor's Assets tab or `olr-cli asset place`. It is a folder, `<asset-id>/`, holding `asset.ron` (its name, the art scale it was made at, its size, its elements and folders, the glow groups and surface materials they name, and (issue #71) its states, exposed properties, sounds and health), the elements' files (`images/<source>`, `layers/<id>.png`, `layers/<id>.material.png`, `layers/<id>.back.png`, `masks/<id>.png`, `glow/<id>.png`, `surface/<id>.png`, `surface/<id>.back.png`: a level composition's `editor/` files, without `editor/`), its sounds (`sounds/<file>`, WAV or Ogg, each at most 2 MiB), an optional default script (`script.rhai`, UTF-8 Rhai, at most 64 KiB, read when present; not run yet) and `thumb.png`, the asset drawn lit under a dark preview look. Elements are a level's composition elements (see the level page), placed relative to the asset's top-left corner; a library asset holds no raster and no distant layer. A drawn layer owned by states stacks their pictures in its own files: with its box `w` × `h` world pixels at art scale `s` and owned by n states (in `states` order), `layers/<id>.png` is `w·s` × `h·s·(1 + n)`, rows `0` to `h·s` the starting state's picture and rows `k·h·s` to `(k + 1)·h·s` the k-th owner's; `layers/<id>.material.png` (`w` × `h·(1 + n)`), `layers/<id>.back.png` and `glow/<id>.png` stack the same way, while surface maps and image masks are the starting state's in every state. An asset without states, exposed properties, sounds, health or script is written exactly as before them. A placed asset is ordinary elements: no level refers to its folder. An asset folder is untrusted content: reading checks it with the level format's limits.

<a id="assetfile"></a>

## AssetFile (`asset.ron`)

`asset.ron`: what the asset is.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | required | Shown in the editor's Assets tab: 1 to `MAX_ASSET_NAME` (64) characters, no control characters. |
| `art_scale` | integer | `1` | Art pixels per world pixel the asset was made at, 1 to `MAX_ART_SCALE` (8); placing it in a level of another art scale resamples it, as a paste does. Default 1. |
| `size` | (integer, integer) | required | The asset's width and height, world pixels, each 1 to `MAX_SIDE` (4096): where it lands when placed, its top-left at the point. |
| `elements` | list of [Element](#element) | required | Its elements, bottom to top, 1 to `MAX_ELEMENTS` (256), each placed relative to the asset's top-left (a drawn layer without a size is the asset's size); images and drawn layers only (a level's own asset may also hold a raster and distant layers). |
| `folders` | list of [Folder](#folder) | `[]` | Its layer folders (issue #59), with a level composition's folder rules (issue #71). Default none. |
| `glow_groups` | list of [GlowGroupSource](#glowgroupsource) | `[]` | The glow groups its elements name, each named by one at least. Placed in a level, a group the level has (by id) is joined, its own settings kept; a missing one is added with these. Default none. |
| `materials` | list of [MaterialSource](#materialsource) | `[]` | The surface materials its elements name (issue #38), at most 255, ids unique, each named by one at least (a `surface`, a `back_surface` or a painted map's value: `v` is `materials[v - 1]` here, as in a level). Placed in a level, a material the level has (by id) is joined, its own settings kept, and the painted maps follow its index there; a missing one is added with these. Default none. |
| `states` | list of [StateSource](#statesource) | `[(name: "Normal")]` | Its named looks (issue #71), 1 to `MAX_STATES` (32), one of them the starting state. Default one state, `Normal`, owning and setting nothing; written `[(name: "Normal")]`. |
| `start` | string (optional) | none | The starting state's name. Default none: the first state (left out when it names the first). |
| `exposed` | list of [ExposedSource](#exposedsource) | `[]` | The settable values given a name scripts use (issue #71), at most `MAX_EXPOSED` (64). The asset's states need no entry: every asset can be put in any of its states by name. Default none. |
| `sounds` | list of string | `[]` | The files in `sounds/` (issue #71), at most `MAX_ASSET_SOUNDS` (16), each `[a-z0-9_-]` 1 to 32 bytes then `.wav` or `.ogg`, unique case aside. A sound no state names may be played by a script. Default none. |
| `health` | [HealthSource](#healthsource) (optional) | none | The asset can be destroyed (issue #71). Default none. |

Example:

```ron
(
    name: "Torch",
    size: (14, 16),
    elements: [
        (
            id: "torch",
            name: "Torch",
            kind: Drawn(
                material: Background,
                size: (14, 16),
            ),
            glow: (
                strength: 100,
                group: "flames",
                mask: true,
            ),
        ),
    ],
    glow_groups: [
        (
            id: "flames",
            intensity: 900,
            reach: Pixels(100),
            animation: Flicker(
                speed: 9,
                depth: 35,
            ),
        ),
    ],
)
```

<a id="element"></a>

## Element

One element of a composition.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | required | A slug unique in the level (`[a-z0-9_.-]`, not starting with `.`); names its files. |
| `name` | string | `""` | Shown in the editor's element list. |
| `visible` | boolean | `true` | Hidden elements are left out of the bake. Default true. |
| `locked` | boolean | `false` | The editor does not change a locked element. |
| `folder` | string (optional) | none | The id of its innermost folder (issue #59); none: the top level. An asset's elements name the asset's own folders (issue #71). Default none. |
| `kind` | [ElementKind](#elementkind) | required | What the element is. |
| `glow` | [ElementGlow](#elementglow) (optional) | none | Its pixels glow (look system): an image or drawn element only. Default none. |
| `clear` | boolean | `false` | Its rock and dirt let light through (look system §Clear solids): worms and projectiles still collide. An image or drawn element only. Default false. |
| `glass` | [ElementGlass](#elementglass) (optional) | none | Its covered background pixels are glass (the background glass design): see-through at its opacity where the level has distant layers, lit as the layer behind them. A background image or drawn element only, not distant (on a mixed layer, its background pixels). Default none. |
| `distant` | integer (optional) | none | A distant (parallax) layer (issue #11): its depth, percent, 1 (near: it scrolls and is lit almost like the level) to 99 (far: almost still, ambient light only). It shows through the see-through back pixels the elements in front leave uncovered, moving by `1 - depth` of the camera's movement; its box lies where it is drawn with the camera (the view's centre) at the level's centre. Decoration only: no collision material, never clear; one `surface` for the whole layer. It may glow (issue #62): its light falls on the level from its box (the camera at the level's centre), its picture glows where it is drawn. A Background image or plain drawn layer only, and every distant element lies below every other one; a library asset carries none (a level's own asset may). Default none. |
| `surface` | string (optional) | none | Its pixels' surface material (issue #37; presentation only): the id of one of `level.ron`'s `look.materials`. It lands where its pixels land: a Rock or Dirt element's in `look/surface.png`, a Background element's in `look/surface-back.png`; on a mixed layer each pixel by its own collision material, and on a raster its solid pixels in front (its background pixels show its back art: `back_surface`). A distant layer takes it for the whole layer. In an asset, one of the asset's `materials` (issue #38). Default none. |
| `back_surface` | string (optional) | none | Its back art's surface material: the id of one of the look's materials, landing in `look/surface-back.png`. Only with back art (a drawn layer with `back`, a raster). Default none. |
| `surface_map` | boolean | `false` | A painted map of its pixels' surface materials (`editor/surface/<id>.png`, 8-bit grey at world resolution: its box, a raster's the level's size): `v` is the look's `materials[v - 1]`, 0 its `surface`. Not on a distant layer. Default false. |
| `back_surface_map` | boolean | `false` | A painted map of its back art's surface materials (`editor/surface/<id>.back.png`, as `surface_map`'s; 0 its `back_surface`). Only with back art. Default false. |

<a id="folder"></a>

## Folder

A layer folder of a composition (issue #59): its members are shown, hidden and locked with it.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | required | A slug unique in the level among the elements' and folders' ids (`[a-z0-9_.-]`, not starting with `.`). |
| `name` | string | `""` | Shown in the editor's element list. |
| `visible` | boolean | `true` | A hidden folder hides every member: an element is baked when it and every folder holding it are visible. Default true. |
| `locked` | boolean | `false` | A locked folder locks every member: an element is locked when it or any folder holding it is. Default false. |
| `collapsed` | boolean | `false` | Folded shut in the editor's element list (the editor's only). Default false. |
| `parent` | string (optional) | none | The id of the folder holding it; none: the top level. Default none. |

<a id="glowgroupsource"></a>

## GlowGroupSource

A group of glowing pixels: how they light the world and animate. The pixels name it in `look/groups.png` by 1 + its index (0 is no group).

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | required | A slug unique in the level (`[a-z0-9_.-]`); the editor's elements name it. |
| `colour` | [GlowColourSource](#glowcoloursource) | `Own` | Default `Own`. |
| `intensity` | integer | `100` | The glowing surface's brightness, percent, 0 to 1000. Default 100. |
| `reach` | [ReachSource](#reachsource) | required | How far its light reaches; `Unlimited` lights the whole level (a sun). |
| `animation` | [AnimationSource](#animationsource) | `Steady` | Default `Steady`. |
| `phase_ms` | integer (optional) | none | Default none: from the group's id. |

<a id="materialsource"></a>

## MaterialSource

A surface material: a file `<id>.ron` of a material library, or one of a level's `look.materials`.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | required | 1 to 64 bytes of `[a-z0-9_-]`, starting with a letter or digit; unique in a level, and a library file's name (`<id>.ron`). A level's elements name it. |
| `name` | string | required | Shown in the editors, 1 to 64 characters. |
| `notes` | string | `""` | Free text for authors; ignored by the game. |
| `light_soak` | integer (optional) | none | How deep light soaks into its rock and dirt from the air beside them, world pixels, 0 to 12 (issue #57): thin for concrete and stone, deeper for furniture. Default none: the level's `look.light_soak`. |
| `heat` | [HeatSource](#heatsource) (optional) | none | How it takes heat, spreads it, loses it and shows it. Default none: it never heats. |

<a id="statesource"></a>

## StateSource

A named look of the asset (the design's call 3): its own pictures of some drawn layers, its own values, its sounds.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | required | 1 to `MAX_STATE_NAME` (32) characters: letters, digits, spaces, `-` and `_`, no space first or last; unique in the asset ignoring ASCII case. Scripts and the editor name the state by it. |
| `own` | list of string | `[]` | The ids of the drawn layers whose picture this state paints itself, each at most once; their pictures are stacked below the starting state's in the layer's own files (see the files). Every other layer shows the starting state's pixels. Not an image, raster or distant layer; the starting state owns none. Default none. |
| `values` | list of [StateValue](#statevalue) | `[]` | What this state sets, at most one value per property (and per glow group for the group properties). A state is a complete look: entering it sets every property any state sets, to this state's value or else to the property's default. Default none. |
| `loop_sound` | string (optional) | none | A name in `sounds`, looped while the state lasts. Default none. |
| `enter_sound` | string (optional) | none | A name in `sounds`, played once when the state is entered. Default none. |

<a id="exposedsource"></a>

## ExposedSource

A settable value given a name scripts use (the design's call 5).

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | required | `[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*`, 1 to `MAX_EXPOSED_NAME` (32) bytes, unique in the asset; scripts and a placed copy's values name it (`claw_x`). |
| `property` | [PropertySource](#propertysource) | required | What it sets; at most one exposed entry per property, and per glow group for the group properties. |
| `default` | [ValueSource](#valuesource) (optional) | none | The property's default, used wherever no state value and no copy's value applies: of its type, within `min` to `max`. A `GlowColour` on a group whose colour is `Own` needs one; an exposed `Health`'s is `health.points`. Default none: the layer's own setting. |
| `min` | integer (optional) | none | The least value, an `Int` property only, within its range; required for `X`, `Y`, `OffsetX` and `OffsetY`. Default none: the range's. |
| `max` | integer (optional) | none | The greatest value, an `Int` property only, within its range, at least `min`; required for `X`, `Y`, `OffsetX` and `OffsetY`. Default none: the range's. |

<a id="healthsource"></a>

## HealthSource

The asset can be destroyed (the design's call 21).

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `points` | integer | required | 1 to `MAX_HEALTH` (10000), in the units of worm damage. |
| `at_zero` | string | required | The name of the state entered when the health reaches 0. |

<a id="elementkind"></a>

## ElementKind (enum)

What an element is.

| Variant | Fields | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Image` | `material`, `source`, `at`, `size`, `pixel_size`, `colours`, `dither`, `alpha_threshold`, `mask` | An imported picture (`editor/images/<source>`), placed in a box and pixelated. |
| `Drawn` | `material`, `at`, `size`, `mixed`, `back` | A layer painted with brushes and shapes (`editor/layers/<id>.png`, its box × art scale; alpha 0 = not covered). |
| `Raster` | — | A whole level's own material, front and back (`editor/layers/<id>.material.png`, `.front.png`, `.back.png`). |

### `ElementKind::Image`

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `material` | [ElementMaterial](#elementmaterial) | required | What its covered pixels are. |
| `source` | string | required | The original's file name under `editor/images/` (`png`, `jpg`, `jpeg`). |
| `at` | (integer, integer) | required | The box's top-left, world pixels; may lie outside the level. |
| `size` | (integer, integer) | required | The box's width and height, world pixels, each 1 to `MAX_SIDE` (4096). |
| `pixel_size` | integer | `1` | Art pixels per element pixel, 1 to `MAX_PIXEL_SIZE` (64). Default 1. |
| `colours` | integer (optional) | none | Colour reduction: none, or 2 to 256 colours (median cut). |
| `dither` | [Dither](#dither) | `None` | Dithering when colours are reduced. |
| `alpha_threshold` | integer | `128` | Alpha at or above which a pixel is covered, 0 to 255. Default 128. |
| `mask` | boolean | `false` | A mask over the original (`editor/masks/<id>.png`, a grey image of the original's size as it is shown, EXIF-turned: 0 erased, anything else kept), applied before resampling. Default false. |

### `ElementKind::Drawn`

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `material` | [ElementMaterial](#elementmaterial) | required | What its covered pixels are; on a mixed layer, what new paint is by default. |
| `at` | (integer, integer) | `(0, 0)` | The layer's top-left, world pixels; may lie outside the level. Default (0, 0). |
| `size` | (integer, integer) (optional) | none | The layer's width and height, world pixels, each 1 to `MAX_SIDE` (4096); none: the level's size (it follows a resize). Default none. |
| `mixed` | boolean | `false` | A material per world pixel of the layer (`editor/layers/<id>.material.png`, `material.png`'s palette) instead of `material`. Default false. |
| `back` | boolean | `false` | A back art (`editor/layers/<id>.back.png`, the layer's art size): what shows where its dirt or rock is carved. Default false. |

<a id="elementglow"></a>

## ElementGlow

How an element's covered pixels glow: they show at `strength` whatever the darkness, and cast light as their glow group says.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `strength` | integer | required | Percent, 1 to 100. |
| `group` | string | required | The id of a glow group in `level.ron`'s `look`. |
| `mask` | boolean | `false` | A painted mask (`editor/glow/<id>.png`, grey, the element's box at art resolution: 0 no glow to 255 full) scales the strength per pixel. Default false. |
| `beam` | [GlowBeam](#glowbeam) (optional) | none | Makes the glow directional (the directional-glow design): its pixels cast a cone of light instead of a halo. Rock and background only, not on a distant layer, and its group's reach must be `Pixels`. Default none. |

<a id="elementglass"></a>

## ElementGlass

How an element's covered background pixels are glass: what of the distant layers behind them shows, and how.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `opacity` | integer | required | Percent, 1 to 99: how much of the glass's own colour lies over what is behind it. |
| `tint` | integer | `0` | Percent, 0 to 100: how strongly what shows through is multiplied by the glass's colour (0 clear). Lit levels only. Default 0. |
| `frost` | integer | `0` | Tenths of a world pixel, 0 to `MAX_GLASS_FROST` (40): how far a glass pixel may shift what shows through it, fixed to the glass (0 clear). Lit levels only. Default 0. |

<a id="glowcoloursource"></a>

## GlowColourSource (enum)

What colour a glow group's pixels cast (their own glow always shows their art).

| Variant | Fields | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Own` | — | Each pixel's art colour. |
| `Tint` | [colour](#colour) | One colour; opaque. |
| `Filtered` | [colour](#colour) | One colour (opaque) filtered by each pixel's art colour, scaled so its brightest channel is full: a stained window casts its light in each pane's colour (the background glass design). |

<a id="reachsource"></a>

## ReachSource (enum)

How far a light reaches: it fades to nothing there.

| Variant | Fields | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Pixels` | integer | World pixels, 1 to 4096. |
| `Unlimited` | — | No fade (in a level, glow light reaches across the whole level). |

<a id="animationsource"></a>

## AnimationSource (enum)

How a light's intensity changes over time. Levels are percent of its intensity (0 to 1000), times milliseconds. The clock is the match's (a mod's light: the projectile's age, or the time since its flash began).

| Variant | Fields | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Steady` | — | Constant. |
| `Pulse` | `period_ms`, `low`, `high`, `shape` | Between `low` and `high` over `period_ms` (1 to 600 000), starting at the midpoint and rising. |
| `Flicker` | `speed`, `depth` | A flame's unsteadiness: smooth noise, the same on every machine. |
| `Keys` | `keys`, `looped` | A hand-made curve, linear between keys. |

### `AnimationSource::Pulse`

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `period_ms` | integer | required | Milliseconds, 1 to 600 000. |
| `low` | integer | required | Percent, 0 to 1000. |
| `high` | integer | required | Percent, 0 to 1000. |
| `shape` | [PulseShape](#pulseshape) | `Sine` | The wave. Default `Sine`. |

### `AnimationSource::Flicker`

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `speed` | integer | required | Changes a second, 1 to 1000. |
| `depth` | integer | required | How far it dims, percent, 0 to 100. |

### `AnimationSource::Keys`

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `keys` | list of [keysource](#keysource) | required | 1 to 64 keys, their times not decreasing. |
| `looped` | boolean | `false` | Repeats after the last key; otherwise the light ends there (a flash). Default false. |

<a id="heatsource"></a>

## HeatSource

A material's heat. Explosions deposit heat; it spreads between neighbouring pixels, soaks in and cools to the air, by these values. Each is percent of the engine's reference material, stone (100).

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sensitivity` | integer | `100` | How much of the deposited heat a pixel takes, percent, 0 to 100 (0: it never heats, as without `heat`). Default 100. |
| `capacity` | integer | required | How much heat it takes to warm a pixel, percent of stone's, 10 to 1000: higher warms less from the same blast and holds its heat longer. |
| `conductivity` | integer | required | How fast heat spreads to neighbouring pixels of materials that conduct, and so how deep it soaks in, percent of stone's, 0 (none) to 1000. |
| `cooling` | integer | required | How fast a pixel beside air loses its heat to it, percent of stone's, 1 to 1000. |
| `look` | [HeatLookSource](#heatlooksource) | each field's default | How it looks hot. Default: the engine's ramp, every glow cast as light. |

<a id="statevalue"></a>

## StateValue

A value a state sets.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `property` | [PropertySource](#propertysource) | required | What it sets. |
| `value` | [ValueSource](#valuesource) | required | Of the property's type, within the exposed entry's `min` to `max` when the property is exposed, else within the property's range. |

<a id="propertysource"></a>

## PropertySource (enum)

What a value sets. A layer property names an element id of the asset: an image or drawn layer, never a raster or distant one. Positions are asset pixels, scaled with a stretched copy.

| Variant | Fields | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `X` | — | `Int`, -4096 to 4096: the asset's offset from where the copy is placed, asset pixels. |
| `Y` | — | `Int`, -4096 to 4096: as `X`, down. |
| `Visible` | — | `Bool`: the asset is drawn and solid. |
| `Facing` | — | `Bool`: `true` mirrors the asset left to right within its box. |
| `Health` | — | `Int`, 0 to `health.points`: an asset with `health` only. |
| `OffsetX` | string | `Int`, -4096 to 4096: a Rock or Background layer's offset inside the asset, asset pixels (a mixed drawn layer counts). |
| `OffsetY` | string | `Int`, -4096 to 4096: as `OffsetX`, down. |
| `LayerVisible` | string | `Bool`: a Rock or Background layer shown; hidden rock is not solid (a door). |
| `Opacity` | string | `Int`, percent 0 to 100: a Background layer's opacity (a mixed layer's background pixels). |
| `GlowStrength` | string | `Int`, percent 0 to 100: a glowing Rock or Background layer's glow strength, the painted mask kept (each pixel mask × value; 0 dark). |
| `GlowColour` | string | `Colour`, opaque: a glowing layer's group's colour, `Tint(colour)` (`Filtered(colour)` for a `Filtered` group). |
| `LightIntensity` | string | `Int`, percent 0 to 1000: a glowing layer's group's intensity. |
| `LightReach` | string | `Int`, 1 to 4096 world pixels: a glowing layer's group's reach, a group whose reach is `Pixels`. |
| `GlowAnimation` | string | `Animation`, as a glow group's: a glowing layer's group's animation. |
| `BeamDirection` | string | `Int`, degrees 0 to 359: a layer's beam's direction (its glow has a `beam`). |
| `BeamSpread` | string | `Int`, degrees 1 to 90: a layer's beam's half-angle. |
| `GlassOpacity` | string | `Int`, percent 1 to 99: a glass layer's opacity. |
| `GlassTint` | string | `Int`, percent 0 to 100: a glass layer's tint. |

<a id="valuesource"></a>

## ValueSource (enum)

A property's value.

| Variant | Fields | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Int` | integer | A whole number. |
| `Bool` | boolean | Yes or no. |
| `Colour` | [colour](#colour) | An opaque colour, `Colour("#ff2020")`. |
| `Animation` | [AnimationSource](#animationsource) | A glow group's animation. |

<a id="elementmaterial"></a>

## ElementMaterial (enum)

An element's material.

| Variant | Fields | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Rock` | — | Indestructible. |
| `Dirt` | — | Destructible. |
| `Background` | — | Open air; a background element is the backdrop seen where dirt is carved. |

<a id="dither"></a>

## Dither (enum)

Dithering of an image element's colour reduction.

| Variant | Fields | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `None` | — | Nearest colour. |
| `Ordered` | — | Bayer 8 × 8. |
| `Diffusion` | — | Floyd-Steinberg error diffusion. |

<a id="glowbeam"></a>

## GlowBeam

Where a directional glow points and how wide it spreads. The baked map keeps directions in 2-degree steps: an odd direction bakes as the even one below it.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `direction` | integer | required | Whole degrees, 0 to 359: 0 points right, clockwise on screen (y down), so 90 points down. |
| `spread` | integer | required | The half-angle of the cone, whole degrees, 1 to 90. |

<a id="colour"></a>

## colour

A colour in an authoring file: `"#rrggbb"` (opaque) or `"#rrggbbaa"` (alpha 00 transparent to ff opaque), hex digits read in any case. Written lowercase, without the alpha when opaque.

<a id="pulseshape"></a>

## PulseShape (enum)

The wave of a `Pulse`.

| Variant | Fields | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Sine` | — | Smooth. |
| `Triangle` | — | Linear up and down. |
| `Square` | — | `high` for the first half of the period, `low` for the second. |

<a id="keysource"></a>

## keysource

One key of a `Keys` animation, written `(at_ms, level)` or `(at_ms, level, "#rrggbb")`: milliseconds from the curve's start, the intensity in percent (0 to 1000), and the light's colour from this key on.

<a id="heatlooksource"></a>

## HeatLookSource

How a hot material looks.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ramp` | list of [RampKeySource](#rampkeysource) | `[]` | Temperature to colour and glow: 1 to 16 keys, their temperatures rising. Below the first key a pixel shows its art; between keys the colour and glow are linear; above the last, the last. Default none: the engine's lava ramp (a faint dull red from 100, orange from about 450, yellow-white at 1000). |
| `light` | integer | `100` | Percent of its glow cast as light into the level, 0 (it shows hot but lights nothing) to 100. Default 100. |

<a id="rampkeysource"></a>

## RampKeySource

One key of a colour ramp.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `temperature` | integer | required | The engine's temperature scale, 1 to 1000. |
| `colour` | [colour](#colour) | required | What a pixel this hot shows over its art; opaque. |
| `glow` | integer | required | How strongly the colour shows over the art and glows whatever the darkness, percent, 0 to 100. |
